title: Local constancy of a module subsheaf near a component generic point
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a monomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Suppose $G$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. For every generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point] of an irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $X$, there exists an open neighbourhood $U$ of $\eta$ such that $F|_U$ is locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]. Finiteness of $F|_U$ and density of a union of such neighbourhoods are not conclusions of this lemma.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), the generic-neighbourhood argument before Noetherian induction

proof.text: Apply the generic-generator lemma to obtain an open U containing eta, a surjective etale map f:Y to U from an irreducible Y with generic point xi, a finite locally constant H and a monomorphism psi:H to F_Y surjective on every geometric stalk over xi.
The pullback phi_Y:F_Y to G_Y is monic and G_Y is finite locally constant. The cokernel Q of psi followed by phi_Y is finite locally constant by the existing kernel/cokernel theorem.

Set q=phi_Y followed by the cokernel projection into Q. At every geometric point over xi, psi has epimorphic stalk map and psi followed by q is zero. Cancellation gives q_s=0. Generic detection of maps into a local system then gives q=0.

The abelian-category monic factorization lemma gives r:F_Y to H such that r followed by psi followed by phi_Y equals phi_Y. Cancel phi_Y to obtain r followed by psi equals the identity; cancel psi to obtain psi followed by r equals the identity. Thus psi is an isomorphism, and F_Y is locally constant by invariance under isomorphism.

Use upperStarComp to identify F_Y with f^*(F restricted to U). The singleton f is an etale cover of U, since f is etale and surjective. Apply IsLocallyConstantSheaf.of_cover from the existing GenericConstancy module. This gives local constancy of F restricted to U, and eta lies in U.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09BH (3) and 09BG; K2 Lean reduction via generic generator lifting, generic zero-map detection, cokernel factorization, and etale descent

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_locallyConstant_of_mono_at_genericPoint
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) [Mono φ] [IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G]
    (η : X) (hη : η ∈ genericPoints X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, η ∈ U ∧
      IsLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj F)
